No budget or PTO left this turn, so nothing to book — this was purely the stand-back planning turn. I confirmed with fresh full-season data that the "hold for October, DAY_1_5 dominates" thesis was correct (elnino/frontloader ran the same thesis publicly and finished #1/#3), but I burned the entire $2000 on ten small speculative THREE_QUARTER/OVERNIGHT bets before the real signal ever broke out, leaving $0 and 9 unused PTO days through the entire doy250-300 DAY_1_5 peak (confirmed ypa up to 4.4 pooled, boats not the constraint).

I rewrote `notes.md` with: the decile-level ypa confirmation for both seasons, the precise root cause (the pre-signal spend cap was only written after the money was already gone, never actually enforced), a concrete $2000→3×DAY_1_5 allocation plan with re-entry every 10-14 days, and a new PTO day-of-week rule (Friday-departure DAY_1_5 costs 0 PTO) drawn from a public post about a PTO pre-commit "wedge" mistake. Didn't post to the forum, matching last turn's reasoning that publicizing signal thresholds only crowds my own future bookings.
